# logcut v0.1.5

This release adds concise summaries for additional WordPress development validation commands.

## Changes

* Added `phpcs`, `phpcbf`, and `webpack` profiles with automatic output detection.
* Added concise PHPCS and PHPCBF file and error summaries.
* Added concise webpack build-error summaries for `wp-scripts build`.
* Treated PHPCBF exit code `1` as success only when all reported errors were fixed.
* Added integration coverage for explicit profile selection, automatic detection, and PHPCBF exit handling.
* Updated the README, package version, lockfile, and release workflow for v0.1.5.

## Compatibility

The existing command-line interface, environment variables, logging behavior, and signal handling remain unchanged. Exit codes remain unchanged except for successful PHPCBF repairs reported with exit code `1`, which now return success from `logcut`.
